_about: Evaluation rubrics v1 (D-19). Each criterion has an id, a weight, a plain-words description a model judge reads, and a `check` the deterministic judge runs. `pass_threshold` is the minimum weighted score (0-1) to pass; a criterion marked `required` must score 1 for a pass regardless of the total. Criteria come from G1's shared rules (claim_rule, brand_voice) so the judge and the rule engine agree on what good looks like.

rubrics.title: Post angle in Shane's brand voice

criteria.description: None of the never-use phrases, no emoji, no beginner voice.
Specific over general: names one real number, decision or moment rather than a generality.
No hype words, no pitch, no beginner voice; reads like someone who has done the work.

rubrics.title: Claim rule: nothing stated that the source item does not contain

criteria.description: Every number in the item appears in the context (the source item).
Every URL in the item appears verbatim in the context.
Every quoted passage in the item appears in the context.

rubrics.title: Digest item: summary plus tag plus angle

criteria.description: The tag is one of marketing-ops-ai, agent-readiness, other.
A post_angle is present and non-empty.
The post_angle passes the brand policy on channel post_angle.
